rule dac_gh_0031 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Repository transferred out of organization - repo.transfer outside org"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0031"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1213.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "repo.transfer" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "repo.transfer_start" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
